method.transport: public loopback HTTP without DM cookie; includes download and JSON parse
method.cache: one warm-up per query retained separately in warmupRows; summaries exclude warm-up; warm OS cache; no forced server GC
method.stageTiming: optional synchronous wrappers: inclusive totalMs, exclusive selfMs; do not sum inclusive times
method.work: benchmark-only index candidates/lookups/builds/fallbacks; absent means hooks were not called, not zero linear work
method.stateUpdates: optional authenticated frame POST before each measured read cycle; updateRows measured separately, GETs remain public; sequence hashes cover warm-up and all revisions
method.io: readFileSync only, categorized bytes/calls/readMs; JSON parsing stays in store/positions selfMs
method.response: response.json includes Express serialization, headers and send; not pure JSON.stringify
method.remainder: server time outside exclusive spans; independent medians need not sum
method.fixture: dense remembered terrain and objects; one observing hero; seeded via existing store in a temporary campaign
method.exclusions: no browser/FPS, Wi-Fi, Windows or physical devices; diagnostic overhead is not production timing
